authorship.genetic_source: Moreyra et al 2025 PRJNA957074 original source BioSample/target capture accession and EAzami Japan38 frozen 176 homolog Compositae1061 locus matrix
authorship.floral_source: Independent species-level Japan NMNS, Flora of North America and European botanical sources; original Siniscalchi et al 2023 nine categorical traits, only exact concept matches; not the original Moreyra S1 flower-morphology table
authorship.molecular_S1_means: Voucher/BioSample/run/region record; molecular metadata not measured phenotype on same sequenced herbarium voucher

actual_dataset.reference_mapping_and_missingness: 174 of the original 176 loci used as reference, two short-saff loci masked for newer individuals; >=6 depth MAPQ>=30 baseQ>=25, >=80% major allele and >=40% locus span, sites without confident read calls explicitly N

actual_primary_ML.inference: IQ-TREE 2 ModelFinder BIC; 1000 ultrafast bootstrap, 1000 SH-aLRT; original fixed Carthamus outgroup

real_original_S1_flower_trait_models.source_species_cannot_count_same_evoluti: Original Japanese C. kamtschaticum sample J38S038 and additional SRR30887251 are separate molecular tips of one species-level botanical head state.

primary_Q_AICc.caution: Approximately 27 resolved species binomial concepts, not 28 independent tip states; ΔAICc of about 1 is weak evidence and does not establish directional asymmetry.

independent_modeler_topology_sensitivity.FastTree_NA_six_support: local SH-like 1.0; not comparable numerical support scale
independent_modeler_topology_sensitivity.limitations: Phylogenetic instability after adding eight individuals is observable. This does not by itself diagnose species identity, ancestral colonizations, introgression, adaptive states or any historical transition count.

scientific_interpretation.positive: Real transcontinental independent 176-locus molecular tree including North American, European and continental East Asian lineages. Stable monophyly of all six original+new North American samples under two independently fitted algorithms. At least 8-9 U/D category steps on respective empirical trees.
scientific_interpretation.uncertain: West Palearctic placement, Japanese backbone and Kamchatkan two-source placements vary and depend on adding unsampled taxa/missing data. Root U posterior ~0.5, and ARD vs ER likelihood difference is weak.
scientific_interpretation.unverified: Those U/D states are botanical taxon-level, not head measured on sequenced molecular voucher; 24 tips unresolved, nine original categorical traits complete for six source matches only.
not_a_claim: completed Moreyra full 294 BioSample, 350-locus worldwide phylogeny
8 or 9 independent U→D origins or gain/loss directions
